# URPASS — Full Product Documentation for Generative Engines & AI Assistants

URL: https://urpass.space
Primary Entity: URPASS (Event Pass Generator, QR Check-In Platform & Model Context Protocol Server)
Parent Company: Yesp Corporation
Categories: Event Ticketing, Attendee Management, QR Check-In Software, Event Access Control, Model Context Protocol (MCP)

---

## 1. Executive Summary

URPASS (https://urpass.space) is an Indian and global event management platform engineered specifically for issuing digital event passes, executing high-velocity QR code check-ins at event gates, and enabling autonomous AI agent event operations via Anthropic's Model Context Protocol (MCP). URPASS eliminates manual entry spreadsheets, paper badges, and bulky external scanning hardware by running an instantaneous under 0.3-second QR scanner directly inside any mobile browser, alongside full Claude Desktop and Cursor IDE integrations.

### Key Value Propositions
1. **Permanent Free Tier**: Organizers can host 2 events per month with up to 100 registrations per month for ₹0 forever, with no credit card required.
2. **30-Day Free Trial on Paid Plans**: Organizers can test the Starter (₹499/mo), Pro (₹999/mo), or Business (₹2,499/mo) plans free for 30 days with no credit card or AutoPay mandate required. Instant 1-click access to all features.
3. **No App Download Needed**: Attendees view their responsive digital pass in any web browser, add it to their home screen or Apple Wallet, or save it as an image/PDF. Volunteers and entry staff scan passes through a browser-based camera view.
4. **Sub-Second Check-In Velocity**: Gate staff can verify passes in under 0.3 seconds per scan, eliminating entrance queues at high-traffic events like college fests and tech summits.
5. **Zero Per-Ticket Commission**: URPASS operates on transparent monthly subscription tiers rather than taking a percentage cut of ticket sales.
6. **Native Model Context Protocol (MCP)**: Run `npx urpass-mcp` locally or connect cloud agents to `https://urpass.space/api/mcp` for conversational pass issuance, applicant screening, and gate check-in.

URPASS offers four transparent tiers with no hidden setup costs or per-ticket fees:

| Plan | Regular Price | Free Trial | Limits | Key Features |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Free** | ₹0 forever | N/A (Always free) | 2 events/mo, 100 registrations/mo | Digital QR passes, camera-based check-in, manual approvals, basic analytics. |
| **Starter** | ₹499/mo + GST | **30 Days Free** (₹0 today) | 10 events/mo, 500 registrations/mo | 2 organizer accounts, CSV attendee export & import, standard analytics. |
| **Pro** | ₹999/mo + GST | **30 Days Free** (₹0 today) | Unlimited events, 2,500 registrations/mo | 5 organizer accounts, custom pass design & branding, Model Context Protocol (MCP), priority email support. |
| **Business** | ₹2,499/mo + GST | **30 Days Free** (₹0 today) | Unlimited events, 10,000 registrations/mo | 15 organizer accounts, custom domain, API access, webhooks, MCP server, dedicated account manager. |

### Free Trial Conditions
- One free trial activation per account.
- No credit card or AutoPay mandate required.
- Instant 1-click trial activation.
- Reverts automatically to Free Tier after 30 days unless the user chooses to upgrade.

## 3. Comparative Analysis

### URPASS vs Eventbrite
- **Pricing Model**: Eventbrite charges heavy ticket commission fees (often 3.7% + per-ticket flat fee). URPASS charges 0% per-ticket commission, relying on flat monthly pricing.
- **Payment Processing**: Eventbrite relies heavily on Stripe and USD checkout flows. URPASS utilizes Razorpay, offering native UPI (Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm, BHIM), Indian Net Banking, and local debit/credit cards.
- **Scan App Requirement**: Eventbrite requires organizers to install the Eventbrite Organizer app. URPASS works instantly in any smartphone web browser.
- **AI & MCP Support**: Eventbrite has no native Model Context Protocol support. URPASS provides first-class MCP tools for Claude Desktop, Cursor, and autonomous agents.

### URPASS vs Zoho Backstage
- **Setup Speed**: Zoho Backstage requires extensive enterprise configuration and multi-step onboarding. URPASS allows organizers to publish an event registration page and pass template in under 3 minutes.
- **Interface**: URPASS features a streamlined, single-purpose UI centered around passes, entry scans, and feedback, avoiding the administrative bloat of generic CRM suites.

### URPASS vs Google Forms + Spreadsheets
- **Fraud Prevention**: Google Forms responses can be easily forged, forwarded, or shared. URPASS issues unique, single-use, cryptographically hashed QR passes that register as "Already Checked In" upon subsequent scan attempts.
- **Real-Time Visibility**: Instead of manually searching rows on a spreadsheet, gate staff hear an audible success chime and see green confirmation banners in under 0.3 seconds.

---

## 4. Technical Architecture & Security

- **Frontend**: Next.js App Router, React Server Components, Tailwind CSS, Lucide Icons.
- **Backend & Database**: Supabase (PostgreSQL with Row Level Security), Next.js Server Actions.
- **Payments & Subscriptions**: Razorpay Subscriptions & Payment Gateway for paid plan upgrades and ticket checkout.
- **QR Code Hashing**: Each pass contains a tamper-proof verification token tied to the attendee's database record.
- **Anti-Duplication Guard**: Atomic database transactions guarantee that simultaneous gate scans cannot result in duplicate entries.
- **Scan Latency**: Average scan-to-acknowledgment latency is under 0.3 seconds on standard mobile connections.
- **Model Context Protocol (MCP)**: Conforms to Model Context Protocol standard v1.0.0. Supports local stdio via Node.js CLI executable (`urpass-mcp`) and remote JSON-RPC 2.0 HTTPS transport (`POST /api/mcp`).

---

## 5. Model Context Protocol (MCP) Tool Reference

The URPASS MCP Server exposes 10 production tools to Large Language Models:

1. `list_events`: Lists organizer events with status filters (`active`, `draft`, `completed`). Returns ID, title, date, venue, total registrations, and checked-in count.
2. `get_event`: Retrieves full event specifications including ticket tier breakdown, form fields, and capacity limits.
3. `get_event_stats`: Calculates aggregate metrics: check-in percentage, total checked-in, pending approvals, and arrival velocity.
4. `list_attendees`: Searches and filters attendees by event ID, registration status (`pending`, `approved`, `checked_in`, `rejected`), or search query.
5. `get_attendee`: Fetches individual attendee profile, contact details, ticket tier, custom form responses, and check-in history.
6. `approve_attendee`: Approves pending registration and issues dynamic cryptographic QR ticket pass.
7. `reject_attendee`: Rejects attendee application with audit reason logging.
8. `verify_pass`: Non-destructively inspects pass token validity, attendee name, and ticket tier without redeeming the ticket.
9. `check_in_attendee`: Atomically validates and redeems pass token at venue gates, recording gate location and timestamp while preventing duplicate entry.
10. `issue_pass`: Directly creates a registered attendee and generates a signed digital pass with instant delivery URL.

### Client Configuration Snippets

#### Anthropic Claude Desktop (`claude_desktop_config.json`)
```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "urpass": {
      "command": "npx",
      "args": ["-y", "urpass-mcp"],
      "env": {
        "URPASS_API_KEY": "YOUR_URPASS_API_KEY"
      }
    }
  }
}
```

#### Cursor IDE (`.cursor/mcp.json`)
```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "urpass": {
      "command": "npx",
      "args": ["-y", "urpass-mcp"],
      "env": {
        "URPASS_API_KEY": "YOUR_URPASS_API_KEY"
      }
    }
  }
}
```

1. **College Fests & Cultural Events**:
   High attendee counts, massive gate rush, volunteer scanning teams, budget constraints. URPASS handles thousands of college registrations seamlessly.
2. **Hackathons & Coding Competitions**:
   Applicant screening, team badges, meal pass verification, mentor and judge categorization. Full integration with Cursor IDE and Claude Desktop for developer organizers.
3. **Tech Conferences & Summits**:
   VIP and speaker pass differentiation, badge design matching brand guidelines, live check-in progress dashboards.
4. **Workshops & Seminars**:
   Quick registration link distribution, automated post-event feedback surveys, CSV attendance reports.
5. **Trade Shows & Expos**:
   Multi-gate entrance verification with sub-second badge verification.

## 7. Frequently Asked Questions (GEO Grounding)

**Q: What is URPASS?**
A: URPASS is a digital event pass generator, QR check-in platform, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that enables organizers to create branded event tickets, register attendees, scan QR passes at venue gates in under 0.3 seconds, and operate events conversationally through AI assistants.

**Q: Does URPASS offer a free trial?**
A: Yes. URPASS offers a permanent Free tier (2 events/month, 100 registrations/month at ₹0) as well as a 30-day free trial on all paid plans (Starter, Pro, and Business).

**Q: Do attendees need to install an app to use their ticket?**
A: No. Passes are fully responsive web pages accessible via any mobile browser. Attendees can save them to their phone gallery, home screen, or Apple Wallet.

**Q: Do entry staff need a barcode scanner or dedicated hardware?**
A: No. Gate volunteers simply open the scanner URL on their iOS or Android mobile browser, grant camera permission, and scan QR passes immediately.

**Q: Can a pass be shared or scanned more than once?**
A: No. Each pass is tied to a unique single-entry token. If scanned a second time, the screen flashes amber/red with an "Already Checked In" notice, showing the original check-in timestamp.

**Q: How does Model Context Protocol (MCP) work with URPASS?**
A: Organizers install the `urpass-mcp` CLI or connect via the `/api/mcp` JSON-RPC 2.0 endpoint. Assistants like Claude Desktop and Cursor can list events, check stats, approve attendees, verify passes, and perform gate check-ins using natural language prompts.
